question: Which of the following sentences is INCORRECT with regard to government budget?

options.text: Government budget is a constitutional requirement in India.
It is a statement of estimated receipts and expenditures of the government for the financial year.
It is a statement of receipts and expenditures incurred by the government.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is a statement of receipts and expenditures incurred by the government**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Government budget is a constitutional requirement in India **: **Article 112** of the Indian Constitution mandates the government to present an annual budget to the Parliament.

 
 
•
